title: The measure of an open set is bounded by any common bound on its compact subsets
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let O ⊆ ℝ^N (= EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) be open, let μ be any measure on the Borel σ-algebra of ℝ^N (no finiteness is assumed), and let c ∈ [0, ∞]. If μ(K) ≤ c for every compact K ⊆ O, then μ(O) ≤ c. In other words, μ(O) = sup{μ(K) : K ⊆ O compact}.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (O : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen O → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → μ K ≤ c) → μ O ≤ c
